description: Reviewed rows naming an AWS error as a result other than a failed call (req-aws-collector-outcome). not_configured: the feature is not set up in this account, so the listing is empty-by-absence and is NOT an authoritative complete-empty observation (it licenses no retirement). unsupported_in_partition: the partition does not offer the service or operation. Rows were authored from the 2026-11-01 GovCloud (us-gov-west-1) wave-0 smoke run. A not_configured row must name its service, error code and operation or entity type: it is never a broad catch. The unsupported_in_partition rows are a stopgap until availability is derived from data; replace them, do not extend them casually.
